Local drain experts

Blocked drain plumbers who know inner-city pipes

The City of Sydney is one of the toughest patches of drainage in the state. Victorian terraces in Paddington, Glebe and Surry Hills still run on old earthenware pipes that crack and let tree roots in. High-rise apartments and strata blocks stack dozens of kitchens and bathrooms onto shared stacks. Cafes, restaurants and offices push grease and waste through lines that were never built for the volume.

We work in it every day. Our plumbers clear blocked drains, camera the pipe to find the real cause, and fix it properly, whether that means jetting out grease, cutting roots, or relining a collapsed section without digging up a heritage courtyard. Every job is priced upfront with no call-out fee.

Inside your property boundary the drains are yours to maintain; the sewer main out in the street is looked after by Sydney Water. We find exactly where the blockage sits, tell you who is responsible, and get your drains flowing again.

Good to know

Sydney CBD blocked drain FAQs

Do you charge a call-out fee in the Sydney CBD?

No. We charge $0 to attend anywhere in the City of Sydney, and you get an upfront fixed price before any work begins, so there are no surprises.

How quickly can you reach the city?

We run 24 hours a day and aim to be on site within about 60 minutes for city addresses, traffic and access permitting. For an active overflow, calling us is the fastest way to get help moving.

Can you access drains in apartments and strata buildings?

Yes. We work with strata and building managers every week, carry compact CCTV and jetting equipment for tight risers and basements, and can reach lower-ground and below-street fixtures common in city blocks.

Who is responsible for the pipes, me or Sydney Water?

As a general rule you are responsible for the drains inside your property boundary, while Sydney Water maintains the main in the street. We locate exactly where the blockage sits and tell you clearly where the responsibility falls before doing any work.

Do you clear grease blockages for cafes and restaurants?

Yes. High-pressure water jetting cuts through grease, fat and food waste that build up in hospitality lines, and we offer scheduled maintenance so busy CBD kitchens avoid the next blockage.

Can you fix a pipe without digging up a heritage terrace?

Very often, yes. Pipe relining rebuilds the pipe from the inside using a cured resin liner, which avoids excavating courtyards, tiles and paving. We camera the line first to confirm relining is suitable.
